ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: \textbf{Solution:} Substitute points $A(-3,0)$ and $C(1,0)$ into $y=ax^{2}+bx-3$: \[ \left\{ \begin{array}{l} 0=9a-3b-3 \\ 0=a+b-3 \end{array} \right. \] Solving, we get \[ \left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=1 \\ b=2 \end{array} \right. \] Therefore, the equation of the parabola is $\boxed{y=x^{2}+2x-3}$.
